method: Time weighting (drives the headline): each task has a time share (Anthropic time share where published, otherwise 1/n; normalised to sum to 100%) and a graded strength 0-1: AI = mean of Anthropic task penetration, Eloundou task beta (E1=1, E2=0.5) and verified-product targeting (1, only when the task has observed use); robotics = max of Anthropic robot tier (E0-E3 = 0, 1/3, 2/3, 1) and deployed-robot cover. ai_weighted / robotics_weighted = time share x strength; summary ai_time_weighted / robotics_time_weighted = their sum over tasks with evidence, divided by the time share of those tasks (tasks with no evidence are left out, not counted as 0). Per O*NET task: AI-exposed = Anthropic Economic Index task penetration > 0 (observed AI use); robotics-exposed = Anthropic robot exposure tier E1-E3; safe = rated in either source and neither; no_data = in neither source. Eloundou et al. (2023) GPT-4 label is shown as extra evidence (E1 direct, E2 with tools, E0 none). Time = Anthropic time_share (equal weights when missing). Work activities, skills and abilities are linked only through official O*NET 31.0 files: tasks_to_dwas, gwas_to_iwas_to_dwas, essential/transferable_skills_to_work_activities, abilities_to_work_activities; each element's ai_share / robotics_share / safe_share is the share of its linked task time in each group (a task's time is split evenly across its DWAs). Technology is occupation-level (O*NET has no task link).
